items.name: CoreSpeed
items.tagline: One MCP for everything your agents need: apps, memory, tools
items.description: CoreSpeed is an operating system for agents. Connect apps once and bring your accounts and shared or private memory to Claude Code, Codex, Cursor and other MCP agents. Use multiple accounts per app, including X, with web search, social research and media generation built in. CoreSpeed holds app credentials. Budgets, activity logs and Smart Approval (beta) keep agents in check. Planned: Agent Drive, Mail, Pay, sandboxes, and more. Everything your agents need, through one MCP endpoint.

items.name: Gemini 4 Argon
items.tagline: Google's frontier model for careful reasoning & complex work
items.description: Gemini 4 Argon is Google’s frontier AI model for complex, long-horizon professional work. It combines advanced reasoning, coding, multimodal understanding, and cybersecurity-defense capabilities, with support for up to 1 million output tokens. Designed for software engineering, finance, legal work, and enterprise research, it helps solve multi-step problems while Google gradually expands access through trusted testing and safety safeguards.

items.name: Smooth Recorder
items.tagline: Mac screen recordings that look edited when you hit stop
items.description: Smooth Recorder is a native Mac app for demos and tutorials. It zooms in where you click, smooths your cursor, adds captions on your Mac and puts it all on a nice background. Screenshots get the same features.

items.name: Blume 2.0
items.tagline: The open-source docs framework for humans and agents
items.description: Fast, AI-ready, and zero-config. Drop Markdown into a folder and ship a production-grade docs site with no app boilerplate to write or maintain. Free and open source, forever.

items.name: ChatGPT Space
items.tagline: Create, collaborate, and build together with AI in Space
items.description: ChatGPT Space is a shared canvas for creating, planning, and collaborating with AI. Add links, files, and ideas to build a living source of context, then work with ChatGPT to turn them into plans, docs, apps, and more - keeping your team aligned in one place.

items.name: opensend.cc
items.tagline: The open source email platform that runs on your server
items.description: opensend.cc is an open source email platform that runs on your server. It sends through your own AWS account, so your domain, your data and your sender reputation stay yours. You get a REST API and SDK, SMTP, templates, broadcasts, automations, audiences, webhooks and logs. One command installs it. No per-email pricing, no feature gates. Already on Resend? Change two lines and keep your code.

items.name: DocsAlot MCP Connector
items.tagline: Maintain your help-center by asking Claude, Cursor or Codex
items.description: Create and update your knowledge base from Claude, Codex, or any compatible MCP client. Ask DocsAlot to add a page, fix an error, or improve your help center. It finds the relevant content, makes changes, creates a new version, and publishes, all from your existing workflow. See what questions users ask in your help center, discover what’s missing, and use those insights to improve your docs and decide what to build next.

items.name: Octri.dev
items.tagline: Generate customizable Docs, SDKs, MCP server, and monitoring
items.description: Upload an OpenAPI spec and Octri generates a fully customizable documentation site, high-quality client SDKs in ten languages (TypeScript, Python, Go, Rust, Ruby, PHP, Java, Kotlin, Swift, Dart) and an MCP server so AI agents can call your API. The new part: every SDK reports its own production errors back, so you see integration failures before your users file tickets. GitHub sync regenerates everything on every merge.

items.name: Pass Designer
items.tagline: Design Apple Wallet passes and see the real card
items.description: Whether you’re creating passes for a local fitness center, a small music venue, a global airline, or a national coffee chain, Pass Designer makes it easy to craft and preview passes that reflect your business.

items.name: WikiFix for Confluence
items.tagline: Find and fix issues in your knowledge base
items.description: WikiFix monitors your KB for issues like contradicting pages, duplicates and orphans, and fixes them in one click once you approve, so your team can trust what it reads or hears from AI.

items.name: Sellio
items.tagline: AI customer support in one shared inbox powered by AI agents
items.description: AI customer support in one shared inbox: live chat, WhatsApp, Instagram, Telegram, and email. AI agents trained on your docs, plus tickets and analytics.

items.name: Thinking Orbs
items.tagline: Animated AI Status Indicator Component Library for React
items.description: A React component library of animated AI agent status orbs. Thinking, searching, compacting and more, built with attention to detail on every state and variant.

items.name: Capybara Court
items.tagline: Tiny disputes, gently settled by a capybara judge
items.description: Two people answer the same four questions about a small dispute. Each side is sealed; only Judge Cappy, a capybara, reads both. The ruling opens on both phones at once, fault never 100 to 0. Alone? Post to the gallery, names covered. It all shreds in 30 days.

items.name: Sente
items.tagline: Talk to your coding agent
items.description: A coding agent you can talk to — in your terminal or on your phone. 1. Voice, both ways. Read one sentence (~10 sec) to enroll your voice. Consent-first; the delete key is yours. 2. 404 models on one account — Claude, GPT, Gemini, DeepSeek and more. OpenAI- and Anthropic-compatible. 3. MIT open source: github.com/yukihamada/sente Japan-built: Tokyo region, JPY billing. Honest limits: metered, not unlimited. Monthly credits; top up if you go over. We never clone a voice that isn't yours.

items.name: LaunchReel
items.tagline: claude design but for editing professional videos faster.
items.description: LaunchReel is a Claude Code plugin that makes your videos: launch films and demos for your real product, written as code from your repo, and talking-head reels cut from your raw recordings. Claude does the work; LaunchReel adds a director's playbook, original music, voiceover and a studio to edit it yourself. Export 16:9 or 9:16, up to 4K.

items.name: TinyFolder
items.tagline: App folders for your Mac Dock, designed your way
items.description: The Mac Dock has no app folders, and since macOS Tahoe there's no Launchpad either. TinyFolder puts a folder of apps right in your Dock: one click opens it above the tile. Its icon is built from the apps inside, and you design the rest – glass, color or texture, layouts, icon size, labels, living effects like snow and lava – in a live preview. Free on the Mac App Store.

items.name: Rival Workshop
items.tagline: A bookshelf app to manage every skill your agents read
items.description: The Workshop app shows every skill in your repo as a book on a shelf: the spine is what Claude Code, Codex or Cursor reads before every task, and a bookend marks where each one stops. Switch skills off, make them run only when asked, rewrite them with Claude Code, and add good ones from the web after a safety check. One node command, and it runs on your computer. Includes 150 editable skills and Brief. One payment: $79 until Oct 31, 2026 (11:59 pm Pacific), then $149.

items.name: Art4
items.tagline: Small Art Museum for your Mac
items.description: Do you like Monet’s gardens or Van Gogh’s skies? Art4 is a Mac app that turns your desktop into a tiny museum. Browse classic artworks, read short stories about each piece, and set your favorites as sharp, perfectly sized wallpapers—one-time purchase, no subscription.

items.name: Calnio
items.tagline: Two-way sync between Notion and Apple Calendar
items.description: Calnio syncs Notion tasks and Apple Calendar both ways, real iCloud events with alerts, not a read-only webcal feed. Edit in either app, the other updates. Free, built by an indie dev and hosted on a Raspberry Pi at home.

items.name: Pixel Soup
items.tagline: Dithered live wallpapers your Mac cooks up itself
items.description: Pixel Soup makes your Mac's wallpaper for you. Pick a shape, a palette and a dither style, and it draws it live on your GPU, then keeps it gently moving behind your icons or freezes it as a still. Drop in a photo and it dithers that too. Hit one button for a random new wallpaper, or let it serve a fresh one every hour. Free to try for 3 days, no account and no card. Then one payment, no subscription.
